d:
The Mavericks defeated the Nets, 130-93 tonight in Dallas. Cooper Flagg contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 12 assists 5 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Kyrie Irving of the Mavericks adding an additional 21 points (9-15 FG, 2-7 3P) in the game. Michael Porter Jr. finished with a team-high 19 points along with 9 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 6-4 with the win, while the Nets fall to 2-8 for the season.
